title: Visual Archive Activator
description: A Gradio app for intervening in archival photographs with Stable Diffusion 1.5 (img2img), optional ControlNet, IP-Adapter (Reference Only) and inpainting. Every generated image is saved with its prompt and settings embedded as PNG metadata. Companion tool to the Sage Research Methods dataset Generative AI as Archival Intervention: Reimagining Bolivian Photographic Archives (1925–1935).
